name: Resounding Runes
body:
School abjuration [sonic]; Level occultist 1, sorcerer/wizard 1
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as explosive runes, except it creates a small burst of sound rather than an explosion of force.

The runes automatically deal 1d4 points of sonic damage to any creatures and objects in adjacent squares, and those creatures are deafened for 1d6 rounds unless they succeed at Fortitude saves.
